name: ahoo-fetcher-skills
description: Skills for building with the Fetcher TypeScript ecosystem: the core HTTP client, decorator services, typed event buses, persisted storage, SSE/LLM streaming, OpenAI chat completions, OpenAPI types and React hooks, plus upgrading from Fetcher 5.x to 6.0. Wow CQRS clients and OpenAPI client generation live in the Wow repository's skills.
